observations: Black game console with a plastic wrap covering the top surface.
The console is shown with a black DualShock 4 controller and a USB cable.
The ports on the back of the console are visible: HDMI, USB, and Ethernet.
The console is standing vertically on a countertop.
A white box is visible in the background, likely the original retail packaging.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrap on the top of the console is not removed, which is a common indicator of a used item.
The console is shown powered on in the photo, but internal hardware and optical disc drive functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.
The seller's text mentions an extra pad, but no photo shows it.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty optical disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and successfully reading a disc.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus and play a game.

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware failure or overheating issues.
risks.proof: A video of the console running for a full 10 minutes without interruption.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powered on and navigating the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to play a game.
Photo of the bottom of the console showing the model number and the disc drive area.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
